claims: The Independent is a British online newspaper.
The Independent has been fully digital since 2016.
The Independent is owned by Evgeny Lebedev and Sultan Muhammad Abuljadayel.
The Independent ended its print edition in 2016.
Evgeny Lebedev is a Russian-British businessman.
Sultan Muhammad Abuljadayel is a Saudi businessman.
According to Wikipedia, The Independent is owned by Evgeny Lebedev, a Russian-British businessman, along with investment from Saudi businessman Sultan Muhammad Abuljadayel.
According to Wikipedia, The Independent was established in 1986 by journalists Andreas Whittam Smith, Stephen Glover, and Matthew Symonds.
